name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for esdumanOS
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

How do you think this could be implemented?

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Compatibility and Failure Behavior

Does this affect installed programs, syscall meanings/numbers, disk layouts or
upgrade procedures? What happens if allocation, I/O or initialization fails?

## Acceptance Criteria

Describe observable behavior and the tests or hardware evidence that would
demonstrate it. Distinguish QEMU validation from physical-machine support.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, references, or screenshots about the feature request.
